mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals tightening monetary policy, raising long-term interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the previous month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Combined strength in demand proxies (GDPC1 and HOUST above 5-month averages) and weakness in supply (INDPRO below 110) creates a demand-supply imbalance, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 5-month average AND HOUST > 5-month average AND INDPRO < 110
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 5.4% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing labor demand and raising inflation expectations, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.4% in the previous month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) signals deflationary expectations, lowering real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, CPIAUCSL does not show sustained downward trend, or 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Weak supply (INDPRO below 110) combined with tight monetary policy (FEDFUNDS above 4.0%) creates a contraction in economic activity, lowering growth expectations and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In tight monetary policy regime, interaction signal's IC <0.03 over any 3-year window, or 60-day returns not significantly negative (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sudden surge in demand (GDPC1 above 5-month average) signals peak growth, overvalued markets, and subsequent declines in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, 5-day returns not significantly negative (p >0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 5-month avg.

mechanism_narrative: A strengthening labor market indicated by rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as improved labor demand boosts corporate profits and equity valuations.
failure_condition: In strong labor market regime, 5-day returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) when PAYEMS and UNRATE show the interaction.
